speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. With only two days of fever and altered mentation, I need to know if you have experienced any recent head trauma, seizures, or exposure to ticks or mosquitoes. Have you noticed any new rashes, stiff neck, or confusion about your location?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient presents with a 2-day history of fever and altered mentation, reporting fever without chills and rigors. He denies sore throat, abdominal pain, headache, loose stool, burning micturition, or seizures. Has a history of tics and is currently taking haloperidol.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS)

Given your history of tics and current use of haloperidol, combined with fever, altered mentation, and the absence of headache or neck stiffness, I strongly suspect NMS. We must rule out infectious causes like meningitis immediately, so I will order blood work and imaging.

REQUEST TEST: CBC, CMP, CK, Lactate, Blood_Culture
REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Head
